positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Charter/Time Warner Cable/CableVision set top box integration
   . Integration of the Alticast middleware product Alticaptor based on OCAP stack(Java)
   . Middleware software development and release for the customer 
   . Troubleshooting issues 	

Videotron Youtube POC
    .Integration of Videotron Samsung UHD set top box with Youtube TV app

Charter POC support
   . Integration of Alticast middleware with TWC ODN on Humax World Box 
   . Deployment of Alticast middleware, Alticast browser and html5 apps on Charter Motorola STB
   . CVP2 integration with Alticast middleware

SWAP application developmemt for Comcast
   . Java application targeted at OCAP set-top platforms

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
Providing testing services for a new server platform for AES(Application Enablement Service)
   . Execute performance/regression testing to evaluate any impact on existing applications
   . Verify all documentation changes	

Execute TSAPI sanity testing & Modify ATF(Avaya Test Framework) code.
   . Implement  “ServiceLinkStatus” function  between server and client in DMCC SDK, which is part of services AES supports.
   . Providing intereoperability testing services for AES integration with new GA IBM sametime 8.5
   . Set up the test environment  using Linux server and Windows server and install IBM Domino server, Sametime, Sametime connect and AES

Providing testing services for VSST project
   . Create Test Case Plan.
   . Execute system verification testing
